messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy started: ratecap-service v2 canary -> 3 hosts in eu-west-1. Observed spike in client 429s and token-accounting errors immediately after canary rollout. Auto-canary fallback triggered for some traffic. Rolling back canary now. https://deploys.redwood/internal/12345

Marco (oncall): seeing alerts: rate-limiter error-rate 9.2% (baseline 0.4%), surge in quota_exhausted for API keys from partner accounts. Paging SRE.

Sophie (sre): got it, looking at dashboards (cpu/mem normal). Logs show a policy mismatch: exemptions predicate not applied for reserved accounts when ratecap v2 flag enabled. Example log snippet: ```WARN rate_limiter: token_accounting mismatch: account=acct-42 expected=exempt got=throttled```.

Eli (eng): that predicate is in the new matching layer — probable config parsing bug. Can we flip the feature flag kill-switch for all regions while we patch?

Marco (oncall): @ops-bot please flip feature flag `ratecap_v2_enabled` -> false for canary + eu-west-1 immediately. Impact: will return to v1 behaviour.

ops-bot: Executing flag flip: `/flags set ratecap_v2_enabled=false --scope=eu-west-1,canary`

ops-bot: Done. Flag flip completed at 1971234592. Health checks: 3/3 canary hosts back to normal routing.

Sophie (sre): Confirming 429s dropped to baseline within ~30s after flip. Token-accounting errors reduced from 720/min to ~10/min. Starting a temporary global exemption for partner accounts while we create a targeted patch.

Eli (eng): prepping hotfix patch for predicate parser. Quick plan: revert matching-layer change or guard with safe-path when exemption table empty. Will open PR and request urgent review.

Nina (pm): ETA to customer impact update? We need to notify customers who saw 5xx/429s in past 15m. Severity: P1 for affected partner Integrations.

Marco (oncall): I'm drafting incident note for slack#customers to tell top-10 impacted tenants. Will include mitigations and timeline.

Sophie (sre): Post-mitigation checks: running replay on small sample traffic to verify v1 behaviour. No regressions in throughput. Saving logs for postmortem.

Eli (eng): PR created: `fix/ratecap-v2-exemptions-guard` -> CI running. If green we'll re-run canary in staging only and compare exemption hits.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed and health restored. Rollback id 2026-03-15-rcb-1971234567.

Marco (oncall): Handoff to Sophie for incident runbook and postmortem. I'll stay on standby for customer comms. @Sophie take it away.

Sophie (sre): Acknowledged. Action items: 1) Postmortem doc + root cause (predicate parser regression) 2) Patch + canary in non-prod then staged re-release 3) Update playbook to include feature-flagged predicate compatibility checks 4) Follow-up customer outreach.

Eli (eng): After PR merge we'll run perf + integration tests on partner keys. Plan to re-enable v2 in canary 24 hours after merge with a strict traffic cap and exemption smoke tests.

Marco (oncall): Closing slack thread for active paging. If anything else crops up ping me. Final note: mitigation successful, customer impact limited to ~12 minutes of elevated 429s for some partner accounts.

ops-bot: Incident summary saved to https://incidents.redwood/internal/1971234567 and notified on-call rotation. :white_check_mark:
